        Task Title: Rooftop Garden Planters
        Task:
        A rooftop garden has a row of 6 planters that must be filled in order. Each planter can hold one of two plants: a tomato plant (T) or a basil plant (B). The plant choices and their watering needs per week are:
Planter 1: T (3 litres) or B (2 litres)
Planter 2: T (4 litres) or B (1 litre)
Planter 3: T (2 litres) or B (3 litres)
Planter 4: T (5 litres) or B (2 litres)
Planter 5: T (1 litre) or B (4 litres)
Planter 6: T (3 litres) or B (2 litres)

No two adjacent planters may both hold a tomato plant (T). Find the minimum total weekly watering needed while filling all 6 planters under this rule.

Min water: N

where N is the integer litres.

        Expected stdout:
        Min water: 10


        Python source:
pairs.solution:
from itertools import product

planters = [
    {'T': 3, 'B': 2},
    {'T': 4, 'B': 1},
    {'T': 2, 'B': 3},
    {'T': 5, 'B': 2},
    {'T': 1, 'B': 4},
    {'T': 3, 'B': 2},
]

best = float('inf')
for combo in product('TB', repeat=6):
    if any(combo[i] == 'T' and combo[i+1] == 'T' for i in range(5)):
        continue
    total = sum(planters[i][combo[i]] for i in range(6))
    if total < best:
        best = total

print(f"Min water: {best}")

        (0, 2, 10),

        (3, 4, 2),
